# indesign-nutria-mcp

> MCP server for Adobe InDesign. 198 tools across 34 handlers give an LLM host
> full DOM control — documents, pages, text, shapes, styles, tables, export —
> over a local bridge to the running InDesign application. macOS (JXA + UXP
> panel) and Windows (COM) are both supported.

Published to npm as `indesign-nutria-mcp`: `npx -y indesign-nutria-mcp` is all a
client config needs. See the README Quick Start for the bridge that reaches
InDesign (macOS: repository files once; Windows: in-process), and `examples/`
for ready-made client configs.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp#readme): what it does, install, handler catalog
- [Architecture](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): the four-process macOS path and the Windows COM path
- [Available tools](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp/blob/main/docs/available-tools.md): the generated catalog, one row per tool
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): the modal save hang, port 8120 in use, missing fonts, blocked policy errors
- [Development](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp/blob/main/docs/development.md): build, test, and the live smoke tests
- [Windows](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp/blob/main/WINDOWS.md): the COM bridge and what has not been exercised against it
- [Changelog](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [Client configs](https://github.com/nutriandrea/adobe-indesign-mcp/blob/main/examples/README.md): Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code
